errors.network: Can’t reach the server. Please check your connection and try again.

errors.booking_slot_taken: This time was just taken. We’ve refreshed the free times – please pick another one.
errors.booking_slot_invalid: This time can’t be booked anymore. Please pick another one.
errors.booking_too_many_open_requests: You already have several open requests. Please wait for an answer before sending more.
errors.booking_not_awaiting_payment: No deposit is due for this booking right now.
errors.auth_invalid_credentials: Email or password is incorrect. After several failed attempts, sign-in is locked for a short time.
errors.auth_email_not_verified: Please confirm your email address first – we’ve sent you a link.
errors.auth_session_expired: Your session has expired. Please log in again.
errors.token_used: This link has already been used.
errors.service_no_staff: No barber is available for this combination of services right now.
errors.captcha_failed: Please confirm you are not a robot and try again.
errors.staff_has_bookings: Has bookings – please set to inactive instead.
errors.account_no_barber_login: This barber has no login yet.

booking.title: Book an appointment
booking.lead: Choose services, pick a barber and time, send your request. Your barber confirms – only then do you pay the deposit.

titles.services: What can we do for you?

services.hint: You can combine several services – duration and price add up.

slots.noSlots: Unfortunately there’s nothing free on this day.
slots.noSlotsSoon: Unfortunately there’s nothing free in the coming weeks.

details.phoneInvalid: Please enter a valid phone number.
details.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.
details.consentRequired: Please accept the terms and cancellation policy.
details.notePlaceholder: e.g. wishes, allergies, a description of your reference look
details.who: How do you want to book?
details.name: Name
details.emailHint: We’ll send the confirmation and your manage link here.
details.consent: I accept the <terms>terms and cancellation policy</terms> and have read the <link>privacy policy</link>.
details.registerHint: With a customer account you collect visits for the loyalty reward: <link>create an account</link>. You can still book as a guest now.

summary.anyBarber: Any barber – we assign the free one
summary.loyaltyApplies: Your loyalty reward is due: {percent}% off the services of this booking.
summary.loyaltyProgress: {visits} of {threshold} visits towards your loyalty reward.
summary.depositTitle: {amount} deposit – only after the barber accepts
summary.depositText: You pay {amount} only once your barber has accepted (link by email, within {hours} hours). The deposit is deducted from your price at the shop.
summary.cancelText: Free until {refundHours} hours before – you get your deposit back; after that it’s kept. Online cancellation is possible until {onlineHours} hours before the appointment.
summary.nextSteps: After sending, your barber reviews the request (within {hours} hours at the latest). You’ll see the status right away on the next page and get everything by email.

PENDING_BARBER.title: Request sent
PENDING_BARBER.text: {barber} is reviewing your request and will answer by {deadline} at the latest. We’ve sent a confirmation to {email}.

AWAITING_PAYMENT.title: Accepted – please pay the deposit
AWAITING_PAYMENT.text: {barber} has accepted. Pay the {deposit} deposit by {payUntil} and your appointment is booked.

CONFIRMED.title: Confirmed – see you soon!
CONFIRMED.text: Your deposit has arrived and your appointment is booked. The confirmation with a calendar file is in your inbox.

DECLINED.title: Unfortunately declined
DECLINED.text: {barber} can’t take this appointment. Feel free to pick another time.

EXPIRED.title: Request expired
EXPIRED.text: The request wasn’t confirmed or paid in time. The time is free again.

NO_SHOW.title: No-show
NO_SHOW.text: This appointment was marked as missed.

statusPage.payNowText: Pay now to secure your appointment (demo payment).

used.title: Link already used
used.text: This link has already been used and only works once.

expired.title: Link expired
expired.text: This link is no longer valid.

invalid.title: Invalid link
invalid.text: We don’t know this link. Please check that you opened it completely.

manage.title: Your appointment
manage.cancelledText: Your appointment has been cancelled. We’ve sent you a confirmation.
manage.noPayment: You haven’t paid a deposit yet – cancelling costs nothing.
manage.refund: If you cancel now, you get your {amount} deposit back.
manage.noRefund: Note: less than 24 hours before – the {amount} deposit is kept if you cancel.
manage.tooLateText: Online cancellation is only possible until {hours} hours before the appointment. Please call us: {phone}.

pay.demoSiteBar: Demo shop · payments are only simulated, no money is moved
pay.title: Pay the deposit
pay.lead: With the deposit your appointment is booked for sure.
pay.deducted: The deposit is deducted from your price at the shop.
pay.demoNote: Demo: no payment details are asked for and no money is moved. “Simulate payment” runs the same process as a real payment.
pay.cancelConfirmText: If you cancel, the appointment request is cancelled and the time is released. It costs nothing.
pay.successText: The confirmation with a calendar file is on its way to {email}.
pay.cancelledText: The request was cancelled; nothing was paid.
pay.depositDeducted: The deposit is deducted from your price at the shop.

decision.title: New request
decision.acceptedText: The customer has been told and now pays the deposit.
decision.declinedText: The customer has been told and can pick another time.
decision.acceptHint: The customer gets an email with the link to pay the deposit.
decision.declineHint: The customer gets a decline and can book again.
decision.acceptedNext: You’ll get an email as soon as the deposit is paid.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.text: Click the button to confirm your email address.
verify.doneText: Your email address is confirmed. You can log in now.
verify.linked: {count, plural, one {# earlier booking} other {# earlier bookings}} with this email {count, plural, one {was} other {were}} added to your account.

reset.title: New password
reset.doneText: You can now log in with your new password.

login.title: Log in
login.resent: If needed, we’ve sent you a new link.
login.barberHint: For barbers and admins. The shop’s admin creates your login – there is no self-registration here.
login.signedInText: Logged in as {name} ({email}) · {role}. To use another account, log out first.
login.logoutToSwitch: Log out and use another account

register.title: Create an account
register.lead: Collect visits for your loyalty reward and manage your appointments in one place.
register.name: Name
register.consent: I accept the <terms>terms</terms> (incl. loyalty programme) and have read the <link>privacy policy</link>.
register.haveAccount: Already have an account? Log in
register.doneHint: Open the link in the email to activate your account. Earlier guest bookings with the same email are added automatically.

errors.name: Please enter your name.
errors.email: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.phone: Please enter a valid phone number.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.lead: We’ll send you a link to reset it.

dashboard.loyaltyReserved: Your {percent}% loyalty reward is reserved for your next booking.
dashboard.loyaltyReady: Your next booking gets {percent}% loyalty discount!

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Other devices get logged out.
profile.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices were logged out.
profile.exportText: Download all data we store for your account (JSON).
profile.deleteText: Delete account: open future appointments are cancelled (the normal refund rule applies), all bookings are anonymised, your account and loyalty points are deleted.
profile.deleteWarning: This can’t be undone. Open appointments are cancelled – less than 24 hours before, the deposit is kept.

wrongRole.customerTitle: This area is for customer accounts
wrongRole.customerText: You are logged in as {name} ({role}). Customer bookings and loyalty points belong to a customer account.

staff.noAccess: This area is for barbers and admins.

confirm.no-show: Mark as no-show? The deposit is kept.

booking.cancelRefund: When the shop cancels, the deposit is refunded.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.deletePaid: A deposit was involved: name, email, phone and note are removed. The payment records stay for the bookkeeping, without personal data.
bookings.deleteFull: The booking is deleted completely with all its data.
bookings.activeHint: Active bookings (requested, payment open or confirmed) can’t be deleted. Please cancel first.
bookings.anonymised: Booking deleted – the payment records stay without personal data.

manual.title: Manual booking
manual.hint: Walk-in or phone: confirmed immediately, no deposit.
manual.name: Name
manual.emailHint: With an email the customer gets a confirmation.

services.title: Services
services.deleteConfirm: The service is deleted and removed from every barber.

barbers.title: Barbers
barbers.name: Name
barbers.accountCreated: Login created. The barber signs in with the start password and then has to change it.
barbers.initialPasswordHint: At least 10 characters. Hand it to the barber in person.
barbers.activeHint: Inactive barbers don’t appear in the booking and can no longer log in.
barbers.mustChange: still has to change the start password
barbers.passwordMode: How does the barber get a password?
barbers.resetConfirm: A new start password is generated. All of the barber’s sessions end, and the password has to be changed at the next sign-in.
barbers.shownOnce: It won’t be shown again. Hand it to the barber in person – it has to be changed at the first sign-in.
barbers.deleteHint: Possible when all of the barber’s bookings are cancelled, declined or expired – they are deleted with them. With active bookings or completed appointments: set to inactive.
barbers.deleteConfirm: This deletes the barber, their services, working hours, time off and login. It can’t be undone.

customers.title: Customers
customers.name: Name
customers.legend: Loyalty = visits in the current cycle, ★ = next booking gets the discount.
customers.deleteHistoryConfirm: All closed bookings are deleted (cancelled, declined, expired, completed, no-show). Active bookings and the customer account stay.

settings.title: Booking rules
settings.deadlineBeforeStartMin: Deadlines end at the latest (min before)

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.lead: Online bookings in the period (by booking date) per source – only captured with the visitor's marketing consent. “Confirmed” = the appointment was confirmed; revenue = the price of those appointments.
campaigns.empty: No online bookings in this period.
campaigns.summary: {total} online bookings, {attributed} of them attributed to a campaign or ad.

shopProfile.title: Shop profile
shopProfile.lead: Address and contact for the website and search engines (structured data). Opening hours follow from the barbers' working hours.

outbox.title: Email delivery
outbox.lead: Emails that could not be delivered. “Retrying” = will be tried again automatically; “Given up” = stopped after several attempts.

staff.mustChange: You signed in with a start password. Choose your own password first – then you’ll see your appointments.

erasure.willDelete: {count, plural, one {# booking is} other {# bookings are}} deleted completely.
erasure.willAnonymise: {count, plural, one {# booking with a deposit is} other {# bookings with a deposit are}} anonymised: name, email, phone and note are removed, the payment records stay for the bookkeeping.
erasure.blockedActive: {count, plural, one {# active booking} other {# active bookings}} (requested, payment open or confirmed) – please cancel first.
erasure.blockedHistory: {count, plural, one {# past appointment} other {# past appointments}} in the history (completed or no-show) – this history is kept.
erasure.useInactive: So it can’t be deleted. Please set it to inactive instead.
erasure.keptActive: {count, plural, one {# active booking stays} other {# active bookings stay}}.
erasure.nothingToDelete: There are no closed bookings that could be deleted.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: This page doesn't exist (any more). Maybe there's a typo – or start again from the home page.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.text: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again – nothing you entered has been saved.

consent.title: Cookies & privacy
consent.text: We use technically necessary storage so booking and sign-in work. With your consent we also measure how the website is used (statistics) and which ad led to a booking (marketing). You can change your choice at any time under “Cookie settings”. More in the <link>privacy policy</link>.
consent.noTool: No service active at the moment.

necessary.title: Necessary
necessary.text: Language, colour scheme, sign-in and this choice. Always on.

statistics.title: Statistics
statistics.text: Helps us understand which pages and booking steps are used.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.text: Measures which ad or campaign brought you here (30 days, also with your booking).
